concept: EFS: shared NFS for many Linux instances across AZs
tests: Choosing a shared file system mounted simultaneously by hundreds of Linux EC2 instances across multiple AZs that grows automatically.
expected: Amazon EFS — managed elastic NFS, mountable from many AZs at once. Triggers: "shared file system", "hundreds of Linux instances", "multiple AZs", "scales automatically".
why_not: EBS — tied to one AZ and usually one instance; FSx for Windows — SMB for Windows; S3 — object storage, not POSIX.
